scope: Frozen paper15 comparison borrowing the neighbouring research pure-MSE E-gate algebra, not a new MIQP search or actual E training acceptance
diagnostic_label: Temporary5percent relative physical-MSE requirement; not the calibrated WZZT default
K_rule: historical frozen model0 training physical MAE / physical MSE, declared scale for this fixed-pair diagnostic
loss: unweighted physical squared-voltage residual MSE; one scalar unit change only, no per-cell whitening of the loss
remaining_voltage_error: retain original per-cell likelihood_sd, use exact diagonal E in the two Gaussian exponential integrals
power_error: unchanged Gaussian background forecast factor, AR0.8/channel0.25; independent of remaining voltage error in planning
actual_mismatch: original correlated multiplicative response, causal clipping, AC and P/Q/root/terminal metering; no claim that all errors follow the planning reference
history: full288 training and288 validation; held-out test topology/future excluded from planning
resources: original60 resources, original power/energy/cost, no reallocation or enlargement
warm: one previously frozen forecast-only feasible request; warm only, not restricted scaling

evaluation.same_fee: rotation matched to optimized prepaid fee before execution
metrics: physical MSE-gate margin and relative gain

stop_rule: One attempt at native tau and one at temporary tau. No further tau/noise/resource search for a positive result. Retain failures/timeouts/global bounds.
privacy: numeric inputs, schedules and P/Q/V remain local; publish code, protocol and aggregate results only
